Aaditya, Aakash and Aanand are close friends addicted to smoking and drinking. However, their wild routine takes a turn when mysterious strangers enter their circle.

After the final evening of celebration, everyone returns to work. It's revealed that Aadarsh, Aakash's elder brother, made a bold sacrifice to save him—one that ends in failure and changes everything.
Aadarsh, trying to recover money lost over forced alcohol purchases, attempts to control the chaos. As he makes compromises, the group spirals into confusion and disappointment.
As debts pile up and Salim Bhai's pressure mounts, the group rethinks their choices. After paying off most dues, they plan a trip, hoping to escape the chaos of recent weeks.
The friends must understand soon that the challenging task will destroy their lives.
